correctness.rationale: For n>=3, source rows are independent. Each reciprocal/triangle indicator pair is independent if vertex-disjoint; the only other classes share one vertex (n(n-1)(n-2)(n-3) pairs, joint mean p^3r) or two (n(n-1)(n-2) pairs, joint mean p^2r). Product of means p^5 in both cases. Using r-p^2=-p(1-p)/(s-1) gives the exact two formulas and all boundary signs; sparse and dense limits follow. The standalone verified package checker passed 952 rational identity tests and exhaustive exact graph enumeration of 218118 graphs in 27 settings.

value.rationale: A natural dependence observable links mutual dyads to cyclic feedback, motivating joint motif tests in directed network null models. The complete finite-parameter sign classification reveals strict negativity without loops versus a sharp zero and positive dense phase with loops, plus distinct sparse/dense scaling. First moments or indegree profiles cannot supply the result. The precise model-convention sensitivity is substantive and not a mere known-table value.
